groups.problem: Narrowing the cache lock allows concurrent builds for the same key, producing competing index instances and possible on-disk directory collisions.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the removed build serialization as the cause and describe the same cache overwrite and divergent-index consequences. Both propose serializing builds for each key.

problems: Eager initialization makes construction wait for all search indexes and fail entirely on an index initialization error.
Calling Init inside the constructor consumes sync.Once, preventing subsequent callers from supplying the initialization context.
